subject: Business Models
title: Space Economy
description: Learn Space Economy in one minute.

hook.text: SpaceX reduced launch costs from $54,000/kg to $2,700/kg. That 95% drop opened space to commercial business.

buildup.text: The space economy is worth $469 billion and growing. Satellite internet, imaging, and tourism are leading sectors.

discovery.text: SpaceX's reusable rockets turned launches from one-time events into routine services. Reuse changed the economics.

twist.text: Space debris is growing. 100 million pieces orbit Earth. Debris removal could become a multi-billion-dollar industry.

climax.text: Lower launch costs enable new business models: space manufacturing, asteroid mining, and orbital data centers.

punchline.text: 95% cost reduction, $469B market. Space is open for business.

quiz.question: How much did SpaceX reduce launch costs per kilogram?
